anna-docs: Heads up — my docs PR (refs: #412) is failing the CI docs build. Docusaurus errors with duplicate anchors and a couple of image symlinks don't resolve on the CI runner. Anyone seen this recently? deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Build failed (docs-site): Error: duplicate anchor 'getting-started' at /docs/getting-started.md:27 sam-frontend: Ugh, that duplicate anchor smells like our custom slugify rule. Emojis / non-ascii headings can collapse to the same slug. I can repro locally with `yarn build` on that branch. anna-docs: repro steps? I only see it on CI, not locally for me. sam-frontend: run: `yarn workspace docs build && npx docusaurus serve build`. On my machine headings with "🚀 Getting Started" and "Getting Started" both become `getting-started`. mike-eng: Two parts here: (1) the duplicate anchor slug issue, (2) symlinked assets. For (1) we can either make headings carry explicit HTML anchors or normalize slug generation. I'd prefer adding `remark-slug` + a custom slugify that preserves ascii fallback. sam-frontend: Agree. Quick fix: add an explicit anchor for the problematic heading: ```html

🚀 Getting Started

``` That avoids breaking user-facing headings and is tiny. mike-eng: For (2) the CI runner (alpine container) doesn't follow repo symlinks we checked in under `docs/static/assets`. Best to replace the symlinks with actual files or update the docs build step to resolve them. Example to copy during build: `rsync -aL docs/static/ build/static/` (follow symlinks). anna-docs: Nice. The symlinked images were because I linked a shared asset dir from the monorepo. Should I vendor-copy into `docs/static/img/` in the PR or adjust CI? eva-qa: If you vendor-copy, add a quick checksum assert in docs-tests so we notice drift later. Our linkchecker also fails when images 404; current job output: `linkcheck: 3 broken links, 2 missing images`. mike-eng: I'll add a small docs pipeline job: `yarn docs:linkcheck` + `remark-unique-headers` lint. Fail fast so we don't merge broken anchors. I can send a tiny PR to the actions workflow. sam-frontend: Also propose adding `slugify: (s) => githubSlugger.slug(s)` in the docusaurus config to match GitHub anchors. That reduces surprises between GH-rendered README and the site. anna-docs: I'll open a follow-up PR that: (a) adds explicit anchor for the conflicting heading, (b) replaces the two symlinked images with copies under `docs/static/img/`, and (c) updates the frontmatter note where needed. eva-qa: I'll run the linkcheck locally on that PR before you merge. Ping me when it's up. :thumbsup: sam-frontend: Can we also add a short doc in the repo CONTRIBUTING.md about "no symlinks in docs/static"? That would stop the pattern. mike-eng: Good call. I'll include that guideline in the workflow PR. Also will add a CI snippet that prints the failing anchor lines so authors can quickly fix. anna-docs: Sweet — thanks all. Opening PR now and will ping when ready for review. sam-frontend: lmk if you want me to land the quick slug config change; low risk. anna-docs: Will do, thanks!
